SINDH LAWS
(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE XXXVI OF
2001
An Ordinance to
amend certain laws in force in the Province of Sindh
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 28th November, 2001]
No. S.LEGIS:1/(36)2001, dated
28‑11‑2001. The following Ordinance made by the Governor of
Sindh is hereby published for general information:‑‑
1. Short title and
commencement.‑‑(1) This Ordinance may be called the Sindh Laws
(Amendment) Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and be deemed always to have taken effect from 14th August, 2001.

Non.

2. The laws specified in

PART‑1
FEDERAL LAWS
(as applicable to
Sindh)
1. The Land Improvement Loans
Act, 1883 (Act XIX of 1883)
1. Throughout the Act for the
word "Collector", the words "District Officer (Revenue"
shall be substituted.
2. For section 3, the following
shall be substituted:‑
"3. In this Act,
"District Officer (Revenue" means the District Officer (Revenue) of
a district or any officer empowered by the Provincial Government by name or
by virtue of his office to discharge the functions of a District Officer (Revenue) under this Act."
2. The Revenue Recovery Act 1890 (Act I of 1890).
1. Throughout the Act, for the
word "Collector", the words "District, Officer (Revenue)"
shall be substituted.
2. In section 2, for subsection
(2) the following shall be substituted:‑‑
"(2). "District
Officer (Revenue)" means the District Officer (Revenue)".
3. In section 7, in clause (b),
for word "Commissioner", the words "Executive District Officer
(Revenue)", shall be substituted.
3. The Land Acquisition Act,
1894 (Act I of 1894).
1. Throughout the Act for the r
word "Collector", the words "District Officer (Revenue)"
and for the word "Commissioner", the words "Executive District
Officer (Revenue)" shall be substituted.
2. In section 3, for clause
(c), `the following shall be substituted:
"(c) The expression
"District Officer (Revenue)" means "the District Officer
(Revenue) of a district and includes any officer specially appointed by the
Board of Revenue or Executive District Officer (Revenue) to perform the
functions of a District Officer (Revenue) under this Act."
4. The Stamp Act, 1899 (Act II
of 1899).
1. In section 2, for subsection
(9), the following shall be substituted:‑‑
"(9) District Officer
(Revenue) means the District Officer (Revenue) of a District".
2. Throughout Chapter III, for
the word "Collector", the words "Chief Inspector of Stamps,
Board of Revenue" shall be substituted:
3. Throughout Chapter‑IV,
for the word "Collector", the words "District Officer
(Revenue) or Chief Inspector of Stamps, Board of Revenue" shall be
substituted.
4. In sections 61 and 73, for
the word "Collector", the words "Chief Inspector of Stamps,
Board of Revenue" shall be substituted.
5. In other Chapters, for the
word "Collector", the words "District Officer (Revenue) or
Chief Inspector of Stamps" shall be substituted.
5. The Land Preservation Act,
1900 (Punjab Act II of 1900)
1. Throughout the Act, for the
words "Deputy Commissioner" the words "District Officer
(Revenue)" shall be substituted.
2. In section 7, for the word
"Commissioner", the words "Executive District .Officer
(Revenue)" shall be substituted.
6. The Forest Act, 1927 (Act
XVI of 1927)
1. Throughout the Act, for the
words "Collector", the words "District Officer (Revenue)"
shall be substituted.
2. In sections 65 and 68, for
the word "Ranger", the words "Ranger or Deputy District
Officer Forests" shall be substituted.
3. In section 67, for the words
"District Magistrate or any", the word "Any" shall be
substituted.
7. The Charitable Funds
(Regulation and Collections) Act, 1953 (Act XXXI of 1953).
1. Throughout the Act, for the
word "Commissioner", the words "District Coordination
Officer" shall be substituted.
2. In section 14, for the words
"District Magistrate", the words "Executive District Officer
(Revenue)" shall be substituted.
